spans.s: छुर् vt. 1P (pp. छुरित) 1. To cut, to divide; 2. to engrave.
छुर् (II) vt. 6P (pp. छुरित) 1. To cover, to coat, to envelop; 2. to intermix.With वि-, to anoint, to cover, to envelop, Ch.
छुरित a. (f. ता) 1. Inlaid, set; 2. coated, spread, प्रियापादालक्तच्छुरितम् Git.G.viii.; 3. blended, intermingled, परस्परेण च्छुरितामलच्छवी Sis.i.22.
